The plate is square-ish and spans about 350 px, which I take as roughly 24 cm. The carrot pile covers about 230 × 170 px, or about 16 × 12 cm at the base, but it is irregular. I estimate the carrots as about 25 pieces and the pile at roughly 2.5 cm high. Spread over the plate that gives 12–13 slices of about 8 g each, plus the scattered pieces, so I put the total near 130 g. There is no visible sauce, only a slight glaze.
